title: Recover task-sync custody explicitly after a historical repository moves
outcome: An operator has an explicit audited route to preserve and reconcile retained custody when a historical binding's Git admin directory moved or was retired, with a specific refusal while unavailable.
acceptance: A missing or relocated historical Git admin directory produces a specific custody refusal that identifies the required recovery without silently skipping artifacts or assuming publication success.

A named cold-audit relocation or retirement operation preserves canonical bindings, historical publication-witness obligations and pending effects; ordinary admission remains fail-closed until that operation proves continuity.
Behavioral tests cover a settled superseded binding with a relocated root and a historical confirmed push, failure/rollback and exact retry; documentation names the supported recovery and its limits.
